text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #8a8983

g.text: Eligible studies, 2010–2026; 2026 is incomplete. Panel A shows full evaluation counts using complete study geography, without disease-burden matching. Each evaluation

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #8a8983

g.text: counts once per named country; multi-country evaluations appear in several countries. Evaluations without a named country are not located. Grey: no recorded full

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #8a8983

g.text: evaluations. Small territories may not be visible at this scale.
